how: Each scene is a real render of the game's own code: open game/?shot=<scene>&seed=20261117 in a desktop browser at 1280x720 and capture once window.__shotReady is set. No edits, no compositing.

scenes.note: Title screen: name, goal, how to play, press Enter to begin.
Mid-wave 6: braziers burning, shades closing in, HUD with wave, score, embers and ember health.
Victory screen after all 12 waves: score, waves, kills, best score, play again.
Game over screen: the dark prevails, score and stats, play again.
